name: Garden Fund
promise: Your money funds a named piece of infrastructure — a raised bed, a path segment, a loaner chair — and you see it get done.

name: Garden Shop
promise: Real goods from one Concord farm — plant starts, dried flowers, and handmade botanicals you can trace to a specific field and pick up in person.

name: Garden Visit
kicker: Individual admission & group bookings · pricing confirmed at booking
promise: You get out of the car and into the field — same paths, same flowers, same cutting stations as everyone else.

name: First Call
promise: You find out in 20 minutes whether a garden fundraiser pencils out for your org — or you find out it doesn't, which is equally useful.

name: Garden Awareness
promise: Your contribution funds a specific, named outcome at the only wheelchair-accessible u-pick flower farm in the East Bay — not an operational budget, a real thing you can point to.

name: Into The Field
promise: You go into the field and cut your own bouquet — not to the edge of the parking lot, not to the halfway point where the gravel starts.

name: Private Farm Day
promise: A farm outing where everyone is in the field — not watching from the edge.

name: Little Brown Birds
promise: Color your way through 40 'drab' backyard birds and come out the other side actually knowing which one is which.

name: Book Your Garden Visit
kicker: Private field booking · priced per group
promise: Your whole group moves through the same fields, cuts flowers at the same stations, and nobody waits at the edge.

name: Independent Living Multi-Session Package
kicker: Consulting package · pricing set at intake
promise: A complete, working plan for your specific situation — housing, attendant care, benefits, and next steps — built across multiple sessions with a case manager who already knows how these systems actually work.
